title: Q-CHURN-snapshots: watchdog rewrites runway.json and site/*-data.js when only timestamps moved
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedlife --check
**Status:** open

Each pass rewrites ops/runway.json (30-reading seed_verify window), ops/trajectory.json and site/*-data.js. Write them only when a non-timestamp value changes, per SUBSTANCE-1, keeping the 48 h seed verify reading that foundation/seedlife.py and seed/scripts/seedlife.py read.

**Prediction:** watchdog commits per day that touch only timestamps <= 2 within 72 h

**Out of scope:** changing what any detector, claim or ledger reader concludes; deleting history that is not backed up.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation seedlife --check` exits 0.
